paper.title_en: Survey of Compact Sources for Pulsars and Exotic Objects-II. Precision Timing of Millisecond Pulsar J1840+1102
paper.abstract_en: We present the timing analysis of the eclipsing millisecond pulsar PSR J1840+1102, discovered in the Survey of COmpact sources for Pulsars and Exotic objects (SCOPE) using the Giant Metrewave Radio Telescope (GMRT). PSR J1840+1102 has a short spin period of 1.60 ms and an orbital period of 1.68 days, with a dispersion measure (DM) of 98.8 pc cm$^{-3}$. We report timing analysis over a 2.7-year baseline, yielding a phase-connected solution with a post-fit residual RMS of 2.1 $μ$s. Enabled by the timing solution, we report discovery of pulsed gamma-rays from PSR J1840+1102, with the gamma-ray peak aligned with that of the radio profile. PSR J1840+1102 also exhibits remarkably short eclipses, lasting only around $0.4\%$ of the total orbit at 650 MHz. Based on optical searches, the orbital parameters, short eclipses, and comparison with the known binary pulsar population, we infer a Helium white dwarf (He-WD) surrounded by plasma to be the most likely companion. Furthermore, using GMRT observations covering 300 to 750 MHz, we present a study of the interstellar medium properties towards PSR J1840+1102 including refractive scintillation, DM variations and scattering, and report a very low scattering index of $1.65\pm0.15$. The low timing residuals and lack of any prominent orbital parameters or DM variations support the overall suitability of PSR J1840+1102 for inclusion in the pulsar timing array campaigns.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文报告了掩食毫秒脉冲星 PSR J1840+1102 的精确计时结果，给出2.7年基线、相位连接的计时解与2.1微秒的拟合后残差RMS，并在此基础上报告脉冲伽马射线探测、极短掩食以及星际介质散射与色散量变化分析，明确指出该脉冲星适合纳入脉冲星计时阵列 campañas。内容与 PTA 主题直接相关，观测与分析链条完整，适合点击进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 脉冲星与奇异天体致密源巡天-II：毫秒脉冲星 J1840+1102 的精确计时
decision.abstract_zh: 我们给出了对掩食毫秒脉冲星 PSR J1840+1102 的计时分析，该脉冲星是在利用巨型米波射电望远镜（GMRT）开展的脉冲星与奇异天体致密源巡天（SCOPE）中发现的。PSR J1840+1102 具有 1.60 ms 的短自转周期和 1.68 天的轨道周期，色散量（DM）为 98.8 pc cm$^{-3}$。我们报告了基于 2.7 年基线的计时分析，得到了一个相位连接的计时解，其拟合后残差 RMS 为 2.1 $\mu$s。借助该计时解，我们报告了从 PSR J1840+1102 探测到脉冲伽马射线，其伽马射线峰值与射电轮廓的峰值对齐。PSR J1840+1102 还表现出极短的掩食，在 650 MHz 下仅持续整个轨道的约 $0.4\%$。基于光学搜寻、轨道参数、短掩食以及与已知双星脉冲星种群的比较，我们推断一个被等离子体包围的氦白矮星（He-WD）是最可能的伴星。此外，利用覆盖 300 至 750 MHz 的 GMRT 观测，我们给出了对 PSR J1840+1102 方向星际介质性质的研究，包括折射闪烁、DM 变化和散射，并报告了一个非常低的散射指数 $1.65\pm0.15$。低计时残差以及不存在任何显著的轨道参数或 DM 变化，支持 PSR J1840+1102 整体上适合被纳入脉冲星计时阵列 campañas。
